Libraries

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(scRepertoire)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

Data

* Read in single-cell data object for analyses

```{r}
## Combined to 1 object
# Data (DS)
seu <- readRDS(file = "data/new_combined.TCR_seu.rds")
seu

# Data
sc_bmark_orig <- readRDS(file = "data/seu_combined_tech_bmark.rds")
# Convert Seurat metadata to data frames
df_orig <- sc_bmark_orig@meta.data
df_ds   <- sc_bmark@meta.data

## By technology
seu_parse <- readRDS("data/Parse_ds_seu.rds")
seu_10x <- readRDS("data/10x_seu.rds")
```

Analyses

* Gene/feature and transcript (nCount) analyses including MT and RP%

```{r}
# combined dataset
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = "^MT-")
VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA"))

# Split Seurat object by sample pairings
samples_234 <- subset(seu, orig.ident %in% c("Parse_234", "TenX_234"))
samples_236 <- subset(seu, orig.ident %in% c("Parse_236", "TenX_236"))
samples_237 <- subset(seu, orig.ident %in% c("Parse_237", "TenX_237"))
samples_238 <- subset(seu, orig.ident %in% c("Parse_238", "TenX_238"))

# Reorder factors in each subset
reorder_samples <- function(obj, levels) {
    obj$orig.ident <- factor(obj$orig.ident, levels = levels)
    return(obj)
}

# Apply
samples_234 <- reorder_samples(samples_234, c("Parse_234", "TenX_234"))
samples_236 <- reorder_samples(samples_236, c("Parse_236", "TenX_236"))
samples_237 <- reorder_samples(samples_237, c("Parse_237", "TenX_237"))
samples_238 <- reorder_samples(samples_238, c("Parse_238", "TenX_238"))

####### nFeature (Genes per cell)

# Create individual violin plots with customized colors and y-axis labels
plot_234 <- VlnPlot(samples_234, features = "nFeature_RNA", group.by = "orig.ident") +
    ggtitle("234") +
    ylab("Genes per Cell") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Parse_234" = "#1F77B4", "TenX_234" = "#FF7F0E"))

plot_236 <- VlnPlot(samples_236, features = "nFeature_RNA", group.by = "orig.ident") +
    ggtitle("236") +
    ylab("Genes per Cell") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Parse_236" = "#1F77B4", "TenX_236" = "#FF7F0E"))

plot_237 <- VlnPlot(samples_237, features = "nFeature_RNA", group.by = "orig.ident") +
    ggtitle("237") +
    ylab("Genes per Cell") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Parse_237" = "#1F77B4", "TenX_237" = "#FF7F0E"))

plot_238 <- VlnPlot(samples_238, features = "nFeature_RNA", group.by = "orig.ident") +
    ggtitle("238") +
    ylab("Genes per Cell") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Parse_238" = "#1F77B4", "TenX_238" = "#FF7F0E"))

# Combine into grid
combined_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(plot_234, plot_236, plot_237, plot_238, ncol = 2)

# Add a title to the grid
cowplot::plot_grid(
    cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label("Genes Detected per Cell by Sample and Technology", fontface = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    combined_grid,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.1, 1)
)
```

Gene detection

* Plot a scatterplot showing depth on x axis (reads/cell) and genes per cell on y
* Saturation plots

```{r}
#
FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA", group.by = "tech", pt.size = 1.5) +
    ggtitle("Gene detection per technology") +
    xlab("Sequencing Depth (Reads/Cell)") +
    ylab("Median Genes per Cell") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Parse" = "#1F77B4", "10x" = "#FF7F0E")) +  # Blue for Parse, Orange for TenX
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12))

# by individual sample
FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1.5) +
    ggtitle("Gene detection per technology") +
    xlab("Sequencing Depth (Reads/Cell)") +
    ylab("Median Genes per Cell") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
#    scale_color_manual(values = c("Parse" = "#1F77B4", "10x" = "#FF7F0E")) +  # Blue for Parse, Orange for TenX
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12))

# orig
# OG data
#sc_bmark_orig <- readRDS(file = "data/seu_combined_tech_bmark.rds")

# downsampled data
#sc_bmark <- readRDS(file = "data/new_combined.TCR_seu.rds")
#sc_bmark

# Convert Seurat metadata to data frames
df_orig <- sc_bmark_orig@meta.data
df_ds   <- seu@meta.data

# ---------- 0) Helper: prepare tidy data ----------
prep_sample_df <- function(seu, parse_id, tenx_id, feature) {
  seu <- subset(seu, subset = orig.ident %in% c(parse_id, tenx_id))
  seu$tech <- factor(ifelse(grepl("^Parse", seu$orig.ident), "Parse", "10x"),
                     levels = c("Parse", "10x"))
  data.frame(
    tech   = seu$tech,
    sample = gsub(".*_", "", seu$orig.ident),
    value  = seu@meta.data[[feature]]
  )
}

# ---------- Shared colour scale + legend title ----------
tech_scale <- scale_color_manual(
  breaks = c("Parse", "10x"),
  values = c("Parse" = "#1F77B4", "10x" = "#FF7F0E"),
  labels = c("Parse", "10x"),
  name   = "Technology"
)

# ---------- Plot l ----------
l <- ggplot(df_orig, aes(x = nCount_RNA, y = nFeature_RNA, color = tech)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggtitle("Gene detection") +
  xlab("Sequencing Depth (Reads/Cell)") +
  ylab("Median Genes per Cell") +
  tech_scale +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1))) +  # <- fixes washed-out legend
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15000)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 600000)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# ---------- Plot m ----------
m <- ggplot(df_ds, aes(x = nCount_RNA, y = nFeature_RNA, color = tech)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggtitle("Downsampled Gene detection") +
  xlab("Sequencing Depth (Reads/Cell)") +
  ylab("Median Genes per Cell") +
  tech_scale +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1))) +  # <- fixes washed-out legend
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15000)) +
  # scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 600000)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

#
fig_lm <- (l | m) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "none")

fig_lm



```

Calculate and plot Highly variable genes (HVGs)

```{r}
# HVG's
# Parse data
seu_parse[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu_parse, pattern = "^MT-")

VlnPlot(seu_parse, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
VlnPlot(seu_parse, features = c("gene_count"), ncol = 1)
VlnPlot(seu_parse, features = c("nCount_RNA"), ncol = 1, log = TRUE) + ggtitle("Transcript count per sample (log scale)")
VlnPlot(seu_parse, features = c("tscp_count"), ncol = 1)

plot1 <- FeatureScatter(seu_parse, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(seu_parse, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2

seu_parse <- NormalizeData(seu_parse, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
seu_parse <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_parse, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
top10_parse <- head(VariableFeatures(seu_parse), 10)

# 10x data
seu_10x[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu_10x, pattern = "^MT-")

VlnPlot(seu_10x, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
VlnPlot(seu_10x, features = c("gene_count"), ncol = 1)
VlnPlot(seu_10x, features = c("nCount_RNA"), ncol = 1, log = TRUE) + ggtitle("Transcript count per sample (log scale)")
VlnPlot(seu_10x, features = c("tscp_count"), ncol = 1)

plot3 <- FeatureScatter(seu_10x, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot4 <- FeatureScatter(seu_10x, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot3 + plot4

seu_10x <- NormalizeData(seu_10x, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
seu_10x <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_10x, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
top10_10x <- head(VariableFeatures(seu_10x), 10)
```

Clonal length plots

* Plot per TCR chain

```{r}
# set theme
clonal_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )

## Plot A — Both chains
a <- clonalLength(
  seu, 
  cloneCall = "aa", 
  chain     = "both", 
  group.by  = "tech", 
  scale     = FALSE
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Technology",   # <<< legend title
    values = c("Parse" = "#1F77B4", "10x" = "#FF7F0E")
  ) +
  ggtitle("CDR3 Length Distributions per technology for both TCR chains.") +
  clonal_theme

## Plot B — TRA
b <- clonalLength(
  seu, 
  cloneCall = "aa", 
  chain     = "TRA", 
  group.by  = "tech", 
  scale     = FALSE
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Technology",
    values = c("Parse" = "#1F77B4", "10x" = "#FF7F0E")
  ) +
  ggtitle("TCRα – Distribution of CDR3 Amino Acid Lengths") +
  clonal_theme

## Plot C — TRB
c <- clonalLength(
  seu, 
  cloneCall = "aa", 
  chain     = "TRB", 
  group.by  = "tech", 
  scale     = FALSE
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Technology",
    values = c("Parse" = "#1F77B4", "10x" = "#FF7F0E")
  ) +
  ggtitle("TCRβ – Distribution of CDR3 Amino Acid Lengths") +
  clonal_theme


## Final figure layout: A on top, B & C on bottom
fig_clonal_lengths <- (
  a / (b | c)
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(1, 1),
    guides = "collect"   # combined legend
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

fig_clonal_lengths
```
